paper.title_en: Alternative Boundary Conditions in Asymptotically Anti-de Sitter Spacetimes
paper.abstract_en: Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes are not globally hyperbolic, so boundary conditions are generally needed for well-defined dynamics. Ishibashi and Wald (IW) determined boundary conditions yielding well-posed dynamics with conserved positive energy for scalar, electromagnetic, and linearized gravitational fields, using nonlocal potentials and individual spherical harmonic modes. In this paper, we determine which IW conditions are local in the primary fields and which are AdS-invariant. In four spacetime dimensions, the standard AdS-invariant boundary conditions set the rescaled magnetic field to zero for electromagnetism and the rescaled magnetic Weyl tensor to zero for Einstein gravity on the conformal boundary. We generalize these standard boundary conditions by setting arbitrary linear combinations of the electric and magnetic fields, or the corresponding Weyl tensors, to zero, and we conjecture that these exhaust the local, AdS-invariant, conservative boundary conditions in AdS$_{1,3}$. Boundary conditions with non-AdS-invariance and in different spacetime dimensions are also studied. The AdS-invariant conditions in AdS$_{1,3}$ extend to Yang-Mills theory and nonlinear gravity in a general Fefferman-Graham setting. We construct phase spaces for these general boundary conditions. The covariant phase spaces for general conditions are naturally associated with Lagrangians containing Pontryagin terms and, in gravity, a Gauss-Bonnet term. In gravity, except for the standard boundary condition, no nontrivial asymptotic symmetries exist and all conserved charges such as ADM mass vanish identically, as in a closed universe. Spacetimes with Killing fields including AdS then exhibit linearization instability in the sense of Fischer and Marsden and Moncrief. For nonstandard boundary conditions, the modified symplectic structure yields new expressions for the entropy formula of black holes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究渐近反德西特时空中边界条件的局部性与AdS不变性，推广了Ishibashi-Wald的分析，构造了相空间，并讨论了渐近对称性、守恒荷与黑洞熵公式，属于广义相对论基础与黑洞热力学交叉方向，理论深度与形式化程度高，对关注AdS边界条件、协变相空间与黑洞熵的研究者有较强参考价值。
decision.title_zh: 渐近反德西特时空中的替代边界条件
decision.abstract_zh: 反德西特（AdS）时空不是整体双曲的，因此通常需要边界条件才能使动力学良定义。Ishibashi和Wald（IW）使用非局域势和各个球谐模，确定了对于标量场、电磁场和线性化引力场能给出良定义动力学并具有守恒正能量的一系列边界条件。在本文中，我们确定哪些IW条件在基本场中是局域的，哪些是AdS不变的。在四维时空中，标准的AdS不变边界条件在共形边界上对电磁学而言是令重标度的磁场为零，对爱因斯坦引力而言是令重标度的磁外尔张量为零。我们通过令电场和磁场的任意线性组合，或相应的外尔张量的任意线性组合为零，推广了这些标准边界条件，并且我们猜想这些条件穷尽了AdS$_{1,3}$中局域、AdS不变且保守的边界条件。文中还研究了不具有AdS不变性的边界条件以及不同时空维度中的边界条件。AdS$_{1,3}$中的AdS不变条件可以推广到Yang-Mills理论以及一般Fefferman-Graham背景下的非线性引力。我们为这些一般边界条件构造了相空间。一般条件对应的协变相空间自然地与包含Pontryagin项的拉格朗日量相联系，在引力情形下还与Gauss-Bonnet项相联系。在引力中，除了标准边界条件外，不存在非平凡的渐近对称性，并且所有守恒荷如ADM质量都恒为零，如同在闭合宇宙中一样。包含AdS在内的具有Killing场的时空，随后表现出Fischer和Marsden以及Moncrief意义下的线性化不稳定性。对于非标准边界条件，修改后的辛结构给出了黑洞熵公式的新表达式。
